description: The chart illustrates two metrics for four prompting/reasoning methods—accuracy and token count—shown as two side-by-side bar groups. The horizontal axis contains the categorical methods labeled CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT (in that left-to-right order), with each method appearing once in the Accuracy (%) group and once in the Token Count group; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The left vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 70 to 100 with tick marks at 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100; the accuracy bars are colored maroon for CoT, brown for CoD, gray-blue for CCoT, and dark green for CoUT, with values annotated above each bar: CoT 91.19, CoD 80.89, CCoT 88.50, and CoUT 88.40. The right vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 800 with tick marks every 100; the token-count bars use the same color mapping and have annotated values: CoT 676.85, CoD 534.24, CCoT 445.91, and CoUT 354.46. The bars are not shown as stacked, and there is no indication of sorting by value; a legend at the bottom repeats the four method labels with their corresponding colors, and the only emphasis is the numeric value labels placed above each bar.
